tools.name: get_admissions_profile
tools.title: Get admissions profile
tools.description: Read the signed-in student's UniCompass admissions profile: academics (GPA, SAT/ACT, course rigor), graduation year, region and intended majors.

tools.name: list_activities
tools.title: List activities and awards
tools.description: List the signed-in student's extracurricular activities and honors/awards recorded in UniCompass.

tools.name: list_strategy_reports
tools.title: List strategy reports
tools.description: List the signed-in student's generated admissions strategy reports, newest first, with id, creation date and profile strength score.

tools.name: get_strategy_report
tools.title: Get strategy report
tools.description: Read one full UniCompass admissions strategy report by id: profile strength score, reach/target/safety universities, profile gaps and next steps. Omit the id to get the most recent report.

report_id.description: Report id from list_strategy_reports. Omit for the latest report.

tools.name: get_major_assessment
tools.title: Get major assessment results
tools.description: Read the signed-in student's latest completed 'Find Your Major' assessment: trait scores, top recommended majors and the persona summary.
